glance.lede: Carmel Pointe has 1-, 2- and 3-bedroom floor plans. Here's what each sold for over the last 5 years.
glance.ratio: Two-bedrooms have sold about twice as often as one-bedrooms — a narrower buyer pool for the smaller units usually means more negotiating room if a 1-bed is what you’re after.

life.lead: A 200-unit condo community built by Western Pacific Housing in 2001–2002, set in a quiet pocket that's still a short walk from Del Mar Highlands Town Center and One Paseo. High ceilings, private patios or decks, and underground and garage parking set it apart from older Carmel Valley condos. See the full Carmel Pointe community profile.
reasons: Del Mar Highlands Town Center is about a 5-minute walk, with One Paseo just beyond.
Underground and garage parking come with the home, which is rare among Carmel Valley condos of this age.
An oversized pool, hydrotherapy spa, fitness center, clubhouse and BBQ area, all HOA-maintained.

hoa.intro: One monthly fee covers the amenities, the grounds, and utilities most HOAs bill separately.
hoa.fee_note: Lower than Arborlake and The Lakes, and it includes water, sewer, trash and hot water.
hoa.also: water, sewer, trash and hot water, plus landscaping and common-area upkeep.
hoa.compare_note: Counting the utilities it covers, Carmel Pointe's real monthly cost is lower than the fee alone suggests.

faq.q: What is the price range for Carmel Pointe condos?
faq.a: Over the last 5 years, Carmel Pointe condos sold between about $540,000 and $1,000,000: 1-bedrooms $540K–$689K, 2-bedrooms $725K–$890K, and 3-bedrooms $850K–$1M.

faq.q: What do Carmel Pointe HOA fees cover?
faq.a: The HOA is about $350 per month. It covers the pool, spa, fitness center, clubhouse, landscaping and common areas, plus water, sewer, trash and hot water.
No — Carmel Pointe has no Mello-Roos, and the property tax rate is about 1.1% of assessed value.

faq.q: How big are the units at Carmel Pointe?
faq.a: From about 704 sq ft (1-bedroom) to 1,387 sq ft (3-bedroom). Most sales were 2-bedrooms between about 960 and 1,190 sq ft.

faq.q: What is parking like at Carmel Pointe?
faq.a: Parking is underground and in garages rather than surface carports. Ask which space conveys with a specific unit.

faq.q: How quickly do Carmel Pointe condos sell?
faq.a: About 5 homes sell here a year. Over the last 5 years the median time on market was about 5 weeks; well-priced, updated units often go faster.

faq.q: How does Carmel Pointe compare to other Carmel Valley condo communities?
faq.a: Carmel Pointe (2001–2002) is newer than neighboring Arborlake (1986–1989) and The Lakes, has garage parking instead of carports, and its ~$350/mo HOA is lower while also covering utilities.
